runtime: ISO/IEC 9899:2024 C standard library (WG14 N3220 working draft)

official_documentation_checked.finding: The standard library headers list no ZIP archive reader or entry API.
FILE, fopen and fread provide general stream input but no ZIP archive parsing or decompression.

limit: Scoped to ISO C standard library only. Platform and system archive APIs require separate evidence. No standard format-aware ZIP API was documented to run.
